referencePolicy: Foreign-game screenshots and rejected candidates are not generation inputs. Slot names below exist only to track requested uses.

pets.name: 烛翎
pets.elementsToAvoid: 全身火焰凤凰轮廓、长火焰尾羽
pets.actualFindings: 靛蓝短尾鸦、铜红翼斑、三瓣颈羽和瓷烛挂件形成紧凑新身份；没有火焰凤凰体、长火尾或伴生火兽。

pets.name: 绛铃
pets.newIdentityIntent: 墨黑短发纸偶女，绛红短斗篷，折扇铃
pets.elementsToAvoid: 长棕发粉色长裙仙女、绕身长飘带
pets.actualFindings: 墨黑纸片短发、绛红折纸短斗篷、青灰短裤、纸偶关节、半开扇铃及纸匣；区别于长发长裙飘带仙女身份。

pets.name: 霜团貂
pets.newIdentityIntent: 珠灰短胖貂，深靛短耳，浅玉宽扁尾，织围巾
pets.elementsToAvoid: 雪白尖耳狐狸、巨大蓬松翘尾、金玉环
pets.actualFindings: 珠灰短胖鼬科躯体、圆靛耳、薄宽玉色尾与格纹织围巾构成新身份；非尖耳白狐、巨蓬松翘尾或金玉环。

pets.name: 桂灯童
pets.newIdentityIntent: 栗发男童，叶帽，木柄桂花灯
pets.elementsToAvoid: 蓝黑长发女仙、粉金层叠裙

actualFindings.identity: 栗发短发男童、宽叶帽、赭黄短背心与苔绿短裤、木柄桂花灯；轮廓、服装、道具和配色安排均是新身份。
actualFindings.differences: 没有长发女仙、粉金层叠裙或绕身长飘带；不采用旧候选或外游截图造型作为生成输入。
actualFindings.silhouette: 大叶帽与短身、分开的靴子及侧持圆花灯形成清楚紧凑轮廓。
actualFindings.referenceUse: Only approved team-ui-v2 style; W additionally uses this pet's new E source.

pets.name: 砚羽灵
pets.newIdentityIntent: 暮紫胖猫头鹰，砚包，卷轴
pets.elementsToAvoid: 白发女性人身、白鹤双翼与羽衣
pets.actualFindings: 暮紫猫头鹰动物轮廓、浅杏脸盘、窄交领、石砚包和小卷轴构成独立书吏身份；没有白发仙女、鹤翼或羽裙。

pets.name: 汐螺
pets.elementsToAvoid: 黑发蓝翼人形少女、金蓝羽裙

actualFindings.identity: 青瓷低螺壳的寄居蟹灵，乳白橘色蟹体、深青关节、贴壳桂花铃与短红绳。
actualFindings.differences: 物种和主体轮廓改为甲壳类；无黑发少女、人形蓝翼、金蓝羽裙或绕体长缎带。
actualFindings.silhouette: 圆螺壳配非对称大钳及短足，壳口云缘与近壳铃形成清楚识别点。
actualFindings.referenceUse: Only approved team-ui-v2 style; W additionally uses this pet's new E source.

pets.name: 苍嶂麟
pets.elementsToAvoid: 白发人形龙战士、蓝色双翼和长武器
pets.actualFindings: Actual animal quadruped silhouette, mineral jade armor, broad muzzle, stone horns and charcoal mane; no human dragon warrior, wings or long weapon. Distinct original identity beyond recoloring.

pets.name: 竹风狸
pets.newIdentityIntent: 棕狸，单竹叶滑翔披肩，环尾
pets.elementsToAvoid: 青绿头发女仙、多层鸟翼
pets.actualFindings: Brown four-legged civet, looped ring tail and folded single botanical cape replace female bird-wing identity. No humanoid costume or feather wings.

pets.name: 赤砂魁
pets.newIdentityIntent: 赤陶小守卫，靛衣，窑炉包，短石锤
pets.elementsToAvoid: 黑发红金衣青年、金焰云座
pets.actualFindings: Non-human terracotta pot guardian with indigo work clothes, kiln backpack and short stone hammer; no black hair/red-gold youth or gold flame cloud seat. Structural identity and material change.

pets.name: 玄潮龟
pets.newIdentityIntent: 黑青灵龟，浅玉水盂背甲
pets.elementsToAvoid: 络腮胡人形战士、盘绕冰蓝龙
pets.actualFindings: Black teal four-legged turtle with shallow celadon water-bowl shell, contained pebble/flower and rope knot; no human bearded warrior or coiling ice dragon. New animal silhouette and prop language.

pets.name: 霞角鹿
pets.newIdentityIntent: 可可棕斑点鹿，淡紫杏晶角，无翼
pets.elementsToAvoid: 白色粉鬃飞马、粉色大翼、蓝金额宝石
pets.actualFindings: Cocoa spotted compact fawn with split hooves, lavender-apricot crystal antlers and indigo short scarf/peachwood pendant; completely wingless. No white flying horse, pink mane, large wings or forehead blue-gold jewel.

pets.name: 月弦师
pets.newIdentityIntent: 栗发长侧辫少女，靛蓝象牙衣，站立持月牙弦琴
pets.elementsToAvoid: 蓝发少女、金饰粉红羽舟
pets.actualFindings: 栗发厚侧辫、靛蓝短上衣与象牙灯笼裤、站立月牙五弦琴形成原创身份；无蓝发、粉红羽舟、乘坐轮廓。

pets.name: 芽铃童
pets.newIdentityIntent: 橡果头盔，苔绿短衣，双种铃悠悠球
pets.elementsToAvoid: 白发男孩、高举巨大黄菊花
pets.actualFindings: 橡果帽/树枝幼叶、苔绿短衣、种袋与双种铃悠悠球，棕发短肢男童；无白发、大黄菊花法器。

pets.name: 绯耳灵
pets.newIdentityIntent: 铜红发狐男，深玉短衣，单黑尖尾，木狐面具
pets.elementsToAvoid: 白发狐耳少女、红白裙、多条粉白尾
pets.actualFindings: 铜红短发狐男、深玉短马甲和青裤、黑叶短肩披、单铜红黑尖尾、木狐面具与拍板；未沿用白发狐女、红白裙或多条粉白尾。
